implemented_requirements.evidence: class MultipleChoiceQuestion in questions.py implements display() with lettered options and check_answer() handling letters, numbers or text. Quiz.run() calls q.display() for each question.

class ShortAnswerQuestion in questions.py implements display() returning the question text and check_answer() with case‑insensitive matching. QuestionBank._build_question creates ShortAnswerQuestion objects for type "short_answer".
Quiz._prompt_answer() repeatedly calls the injected input_func (default input) and returns a non‑empty answer string.
Quiz.score() tallies correct results from self.results; Quiz.run() records each answer and correctness.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Display total correct answers after all questions
implemented_requirements.evidence: Quiz.display_results() prints "You answered X out of Y questions correctly" with a percentage bar.
question_bank.discover_banks() loads all *.json files from a directory; main.py accepts --bank-dir and --bank arguments and provides an interactive bank‑selection menu.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Option to display correct answers after the quiz
implemented_requirements.evidence: main.run_quiz() calls quiz.display_review() when --show-answers is set or when the user answers yes to the prompt "Show the correct answers?".

critical_issues: A duplicate ShortAnswerQuestion class is defined in shortanswerquestion.py without importing the base Question class; the file is never imported, so it does not affect execution but is dead/erroneous code.

MultipleChoiceQuestion._resolve_answer treats an integer answer as a zero‑based index, while the JSON spec mentions a zero‑based index (1) – this could cause off‑by‑one mismatches if a bank uses integer answers.
judge.summary: The repository contains a complete, runnable trivia quiz program. It loads JSON question banks, supports both multiple‑choice and short‑answer questions, collects user input, tracks and reports the score, and can optionally review correct answers. Core requirements are met with concrete implementations. Minor issues include an unused duplicate ShortAnswerQuestion file and a potential off‑by‑one handling of integer answers, but these do not prevent the main application from functioning.
